versions: Interspeech 2024 proceedings text (in24-whisperflamingo; same content as isca-rouditchenko24-whisperflamingo and arXiv v1); arXiv:2406.10082v3 (2024-11-19) is the authors' revision with added 1,759 h and beam-1 rows, used only where it revises the Interspeech claims
setting: sentence-level AVSR on LRS3 and audio-visual En-X speech-to-text translation on MuAViC, voiced speech with lip video; populations: 348 unique AVSR studies (M06, M12), 739 VSR/AVSR studies with WER/CER/accuracy (M03), 1,048 VSR/AVSR studies (M08); dated against 2024-06: prior before 2023-12, [concurrent] 2023-12 to 2024-12, [later] after 2024-12

M06.what: lip features from a frozen AV-HuBERT injected into every block of a pretrained audio-only recognizer's (Whisper) decoder by tanh-gated cross-attention initialised to identity

topics.inclusion_rule: published rule (349-study AVSR population classified by fusion design), dated against 2024-06 for this review; boundary: a study counts under every fusion design its text names (upper bound); versions once by key; target excluded
topics.metric: LRS3 AVSR WER, clean and 0 dB babble

M03.what: two stages: full fine-tuning of audio-only Whisper (680k h pre-training) with noise, then Whisper frozen and only the new gated layers and a visual projection trained (631M of 2.5B parameters)

topics.inclusion_rule: published rule (739-study VSR/AVSR population classified by training regime), dated against 2024-06 for this review
topics.metric: LRS3 AVSR WER at trainable-parameter count

M08.what: one parameter set outputs English transcripts and En-X translations into six languages from audio-visual input

topics.inclusion_rule: VSR/AVSR studies (1,048 unique, lip-reading or audio-visual recognition pattern in the ledger) whose full text names speech-to-text translation output (speech translation, AVST/VST, BLEU), classified by hand among prior and [concurrent] hits into systems that output a translation from lip or audio-visual input versus BLEU used only as a transcription metric or mentioned in related work
topics.pattern: lip[- ]?read|visual speech recognition|\bVSR\b|lipread|\bAVSR\b|audio[- ]visual speech recognition|audiovisual speech recognition
topics.metric: MuAViC En-X BLEU, clean and 0 dB babble

M12.what: cross-paper noisy comparisons with non-identical noise files; single runs; 'significantly' without a test; beam size changes the clean ranking (v3)

topics.metric: LRS3 AVSR WER with run variability

M02.lineage: text transcripts and MuAViC translations, cross-entropy

M04.lineage: voiced speech; babble and MUSAN noise added

M05.lineage: 88x88 mouth crops at 25 fps (AV-HuBERT pipeline) and 16 kHz log-Mel audio

M07.lineage: no external LM; Whisper task tokens; beam 15
